The webhook acts only on a live subscription of that plan's price and never moves the company to an older subscription than it has. A paid plan change ends every older subscription: with a prorated credit to the Stripe balance on an upgrade, without one when this month's plan credits already exceed the new plan (a downgrade). Plan credits are granted once per calendar month at the highest plan of the month: an upgrade adds only the difference, a downgrade adds nothing. 503 NOT_CONFIGURED when the Stripe key, the plan price, or the return origin is missing. 404 when the admin has no company. 502 PROVIDER_ERROR when Stripe fails.
